summary: Fresh first build of Mace PvP hub tested end-to-end. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass (root, stats log/get/reset, forum CRUD + likes + comments, loadouts CRUD, AI chat reply + multi-turn history + empty-message validation). Frontend (mobile 390x844 web preview): all 5 bottom tabs render and navigate; Home +KILL/+DEATH/RESET update stats live; Guide 4 tabs (mechanics/enchants/tips/tier) switch; Loadout build saved (1 build appears in YOUR BUILDS) and deleted; Forum composer creates post (3 posts visible), like increments, thread modal opens with comment added (TEST_ui_comment visible) and closes; Chat empty state shows 4 suggestion chips, suggestion sends and Claude Sonnet 4.5 replies (rich tactical answer), custom send works (u=2,a=2), AND after full page reload chat history is persisted (u=2,a=2) confirming session_id is stored.

issues: React Native deprecation warnings in console (non-blocking): 'textShadow*' style props deprecated → use 'textShadow'; props.pointerEvents deprecated → use style.pointerEvents; Image style.resizeMode deprecated → use props.resizeMode. Cosmetic only, not affecting functionality.

action_items: Optional: silence deprecation warnings by migrating textShadow*, pointerEvents prop, and Image resizeMode to current RN APIs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/stats/reset reuses StatLogCreate which forces clients to send a dummy 'kind' field; consider a dedicated DeviceIdOnly model.
server.py: chat endpoint persists user message BEFORE LLM call; if LLM raises, the user message remains orphaned without an assistant reply (acceptable but worth noting).
All backend routes correctly exclude Mongo _id via projection {'_id': 0} — good practice followed.
seed_data_creation: Test-only forum post (TEST_UI_TITLE), comment (TEST_ui_comment), and loadout (TEST_UI_Build) created during UI run; loadout was deleted in test, forum/chat artifacts remain in DB (TEST_ prefixed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL is https://pvp-mace-forge.preview.emergentagent.com (frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — note PUBLIC prefix, not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all endpoints incl. real Claude Sonnet 4.5 calls (~20s total). Frontend testIDs all present and functional: tab-{home,guide,loadout,forum,chat}, log-{kill,death}-btn, reset-stats-btn, tile-{guide,loadout,forum,chat}, guide-tab-{mechanics,enchants,tips,tier}, loadout-name-input, ench-*/armor-* (7/6 chips), save-loadout-btn, build-/delete-, open-composer-btn, composer-{author,title,body}, submit-post-btn, post-/like-, comment-input, submit-comment-btn, close-thread-btn, suggest-* (4 chips), chat-input, send-btn, msg-user/msg-assistant. Mobile viewport 390x844 used. Chat session persists via AsyncStorage across reload — verified.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 11 review-request features verified functional.
